privacyDraft.title: Privacy notice
privacyDraft.body:
Draft for your review — do not publish until completed.

Identify who operates your artist website and how visitors can contact you.

Describe the information you collect, why you use it, the services that process it, retention periods and visitors’ applicable rights.

Explain your actual cookies, storage and external links. Link the platform’s separate notices where relevant.

Add an effective date after reviewing the completed notice.
